101c4a4d: What is the highest number of Oscars ever won by a single film (a shared record)?
11 Oscars: a record shared by Ben-Hur (1959), Titanic (1997) and The Return of the King (2003). No film has beaten it.
ba3124ff: Francis Ford Coppola directed the Godfather trilogy (1972, 1974, 1990), adapted from Mario Puzo's novel and widely considered one of the peaks of world cinema.
d5566723: Which Christopher Nolan film explores dreams within dreams?
In Inception (2010), Leonardo DiCaprio and his team enter dreams to plant an idea. The ending with the spinning top is deliberately ambiguous.
5e1f6e02: Which Spielberg film created the “summer blockbuster” in 1975?
Jaws (1975) is considered the first summer blockbuster, establishing the model of big-budget films released in summer, with a wide release that revolutionized distribution.
f573d500: Which film holds the worldwide box-office record adjusted for inflation?
Gone with the Wind (1939) is estimated to be the highest-grossing film adjusted for inflation. Avatar (2009) holds the record in unadjusted terms.
140602ce: Which actress holds the record for Oscar nominations?
Meryl Streep has 21 Oscar nominations and three wins. Katharine Hepburn holds the record for wins, with four Oscars.
1dae3c52: Which director created the original Star Wars saga?
George Lucas created Star Wars and directed the first film in 1977. He sold Lucasfilm to Disney in 2012 for around 4 billion dollars.
e0962ea0: Which 1968 Stanley Kubrick film features an AI called HAL 9000?
Kubrick's 2001: A Space Odyssey (1968) is one of the most influential science fiction films. HAL 9000, the ship's AI that turns against the crew, became the archetype of the rogue AI.
7d25cccd: Which non-English-language film won both the Palme d'Or at Cannes AND the Oscar for Best Picture?
Portrait of a Lady on Fire
Bong Joon-ho's Parasite (2019) is the first non-English-language film to win the Oscar for Best Picture, after also winning the Palme d'Or. It is a South Korean film about social inequality.
867b1865: Which French director is known for Amélie?
Jean-Pierre Jeunet directed Amélie (2001) with Audrey Tautou, one of French cinema's biggest international successes.
83f3cdc3: Which 2013 Disney animated film featured the song “Let It Go”?
Frozen (2013) and its song “Let It Go”, sung by Idina Menzel, became a worldwide phenomenon, translated into dozens of languages. It won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature.
916bf484: Which films were directed by M. Night Shyamalan?
M. Night Shyamalan is famous for his plot twists: The Sixth Sense (“I see dead people”), Unbreakable, Split. His final twists have become his signature.
b89e5adc: Which Steven Spielberg war film about D-Day is renowned as the most realistic?
Saving Private Ryan (1998): its opening sequence of the Normandy landings, more than twenty minutes long, is widely cited as one of the most realistic war scenes ever filmed.
9fcfb47c: Which Japanese animation studio produced Spirited Away and My Neighbor Totoro?
Studio Ghibli was founded by Hayao Miyazaki, Isao Takahata and Toshio Suzuki. Spirited Away won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature in 2003.
d4872fe7: Which French actor is known for his roles in The Intouchables and Lupin?
Omar Sy is the best-known French actor internationally: The Intouchables (2011), the most-watched French film abroad, won him the César for Best Actor, before the global success of Lupin on Netflix.
d8d5b285: Which Quentin Tarantino film is famous for its groundbreaking non-linear structure?
Pulp Fiction (1994): a story told in non-chronological chapters, iconic dialogue and stylized violence. It won the Palme d'Or and transformed 1990s American independent cinema.
43c4fe21: Which Korean director, before Parasite, was known for Snowpiercer and Okja?
Bong Joon-ho directed Parasite, Snowpiercer (2013) and Okja (2017), all with sharp social criticism and powerful twists. He became the symbol of Korean cinema worldwide.
a19c5e52: Which Pixar animated film tells the story of a cleaning robot in a post-apocalyptic world?
WALL-E (2008) tells the story of a small cleaning robot left alone on Earth, a masterpiece of visual storytelling with little dialogue, which won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature.
f9eb9dc2: In which Miyazaki film does a girl see her parents turned into pigs?
In Spirited Away (2001), Chihiro finds herself in a world of spirits after her parents are turned into pigs. The film won the Golden Bear and the Oscar for Best Animated Feature.
830980e3: Which British director is known for Dunkirk, Inception and Oppenheimer?
Christopher Nolan is the British director known for complex, non-linear storytelling: Dunkirk (2017), Tenet (2020) and Oppenheimer (2023, Best Picture).
54fd1387: Which 2021 Denis Villeneuve film adapts Frank Herbert's novel about spice?
Denis Villeneuve's Dune (2021) adapts Frank Herbert's classic novel: Paul Atreides (Timothée Chalamet) discovers the planet Arrakis. Dune: Part Two (2024) completes the story of the novel.
885f7052: Which French film has sold the most tickets of all time in France?

Dany Boon's Welcome to the Sticks (Bienvenue chez les Ch'tis, 2008) remains the most-watched French film in France, with about 20 million admissions. Its comedy about regional clichés won over the whole country.
8e30856f: Which 2013 Martin Scorsese film with Leonardo DiCaprio is set on Wall Street?

The Wolf of Wall Street (2013) tells the story of Jordan Belfort, a crooked stockbroker played by DiCaprio, in a three-hour film that offers no explicit moral lesson. Nominated for Oscars, it shocked as much as it fascinated.
3cdd2d61: Which Quentin Tarantino film follows gangsters in black suits in Los Angeles?
Reservoir Dogs (1992), Tarantino's first film, follows a crew of robbers in black suits whose heist goes wrong. Almost entirely set in one warehouse, it revealed Tarantino as a master of dialogue.
ffc781ae: Which Pixar animated film features a family of superheroes in hiding?
Brad Bird's The Incredibles (2004) is an ode to superheroes: the Parr family hides its powers in an ordinary life until the villain Syndrome forces them back into action. A sequel followed in 2018.
b5f59762: Which director made 2001: A Space Odyssey, The Shining and Full Metal Jacket?

Stanley Kubrick is one of the most perfectionist directors in history, tackling a different genre with each film (science fiction, horror, war). His grueling shoots and innovative techniques defined entire genres.
b30fe3c5: Which James Cameron film, released in 2009, is the biggest box-office hit in history?
Avatar grossed about 2.9 billion dollars. Briefly overtaken by Avengers: Endgame in 2019, it regained first place thanks to a 2021 re-release.
a06c5b8a: Which 1979 Ridley Scott film pits officer Ripley against a creature aboard a spaceship?
Alien (1979) and its tagline “In space no one can hear you scream” founded space survival horror. H.R. Giger's creature and Ripley (Sigourney Weaver) are among science fiction's most enduring icons.
fc143838: Which 1997 Hayao Miyazaki film is an epic about the environment and forest spirits?
Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

Princess Mononoke (1997) is a medieval epic about the conflict between industry and nature: Ashitaka seeks a balance between the forest gods and humans. It is one of Ghibli's darkest, most adult films.
7973556e: Which actor played James Bond in seven official films, from 1973 to 1985?
Roger Moore played James Bond in seven films, from Live and Let Die (1973) to A View to a Kill (1985).
cfc7a515: Which Pedro Almodóvar film won the Oscar for Best Foreign Language Film for 1999?
All About My Mother (Todo sobre mi madre, 1999) won the Oscar for Best Foreign Language Film: a meditation on grief, identity and motherhood in a colorful, melodramatic Barcelona.
c981a651: Which Japanese filmmaker directed Rashomon and Seven Samurai?

Akira Kurosawa is Japan's most influential filmmaker: Rashomon (1950), Seven Samurai (1954), Kagemusha (1980). His films directly inspired Star Wars, The Magnificent Seven and many spaghetti westerns.
5d951f05: Which 1988 Tim Burton film features a “bio-exorcist” played by Michael Keaton?
In Beetlejuice (1988), Michael Keaton plays an unhinged bio-exorcist. A sequel, Beetlejuice Beetlejuice, came out in 2024.
31982c19: Which world-famous French actress starred in Amélie?
Audrey Tautou plays Amélie in Jean-Pierre Jeunet's Amélie (2001), an enchanting portrait of Paris and of a young woman who secretly improves other people's lives.
472c563d: Which 2016 Denis Villeneuve film explores an alien language with Amy Adams?

Arrival (2016) follows Louise Banks (Amy Adams), a linguist trying to communicate with aliens, gradually revealing a non-linear story about time and memory. It adapts Ted Chiang's novella Story of Your Life.
2b8552f7: Which 2003 Korean film by Park Chan-wook is a masterpiece of psychological thriller?

Park Chan-wook's Oldboy (2003) was the most famous Korean film before Parasite: a man imprisoned for 15 years without explanation hunts for his captor. Its corridor fight and final twist are legendary.
d344d649: Which 1993 Steven Spielberg film about the Holocaust won 7 Oscars?
Schindler's List (1993) won 7 Oscars, including Best Picture and Best Director. Shot in black and white, it tells the story of Oskar Schindler, who saved Jews during the Holocaust.
3484f16b: What is Spain's most prestigious film festival?
The San Sebastián International Film Festival is Spain's most prestigious, and its top prize is the Golden Shell. It hosts many premieres of Spanish-language films.
3fb3730b: Which 2013 Makoto Shinkai featurette takes place in the rain in a Tokyo garden?
The Garden of Words (2013) tells of a high school student and a young woman who meet on rainy days in a Tokyo garden.
cbf36fa1: Which Iranian director is known for poetic films such as Where Is the Friend's House??
Abbas Kiarostami is the central figure of Iranian cinema: Where Is the Friend's House? (1987), Close-Up (1990) and Taste of Cherry (1997, Palme d'Or) are among his major works.
524f2efe: Which visually distinctive 2014 Wes Anderson film stars Ralph Fiennes?

The Grand Budapest Hotel (2014), starring Ralph Fiennes, won 4 Oscars: a fictional 1930s European hotel is the setting for a madcap comedy about the friendship between a concierge and his young lobby boy.
119c9659: Which actor is known for playing Tony Montana in Scarface (1983)?

Al Pacino plays Tony Montana in Brian De Palma's Scarface (1983), a remake of the 1932 film about a Cuban immigrant who rises in the Miami underworld. “Say hello to my little friend!” is its best-known line.
906aa5dc: Which 1997 James Cameron film blended true history and romantic fiction?

Titanic (1997) follows Jack (DiCaprio) and Rose (Kate Winslet) in a romance aboard the real RMS Titanic. It won 11 Oscars, including Best Picture, tying Ben-Hur. Céline Dion's “My Heart Will Go On” became timeless.
96187334: Which 2003 Sofia Coppola film stars Scarlett Johansson in Japan?

Lost in Translation (2003) follows two Americans adrift in Tokyo, Bob Harris (Bill Murray) and Charlotte (Scarlett Johansson), who form a singular friendship. It won the Oscar for Best Original Screenplay.
3561c509: Which actor played both Batman and Birdman in very different superhero films?
Michael Keaton played Batman in Tim Burton's films (1989, 1992), then Birdman, a fictional superhero, in Alejandro González Iñárritu's Birdman (2014), a meta role echoing his own career.
500d84ee: Which 2011 French film was remade in the United States as The Upside?
Olivier Nakache and Éric Toledano's The Intouchables drew more than 19 million viewers in France. It tells the friendship between Philippe, who is quadriplegic, and Driss, his caregiver.
88342f9b: Which award honors the best actors, directors and films in France, the equivalent of the Oscars?
The Césars are French cinema's most prestigious awards. Created in 1976, they are the French equivalent of the Oscars, held every year in Paris early in the year.
8c574a12: Which Stanley Kubrick film follows a crew planning a racetrack robbery?
The Killing (1956) is a heist film noir in which a crew plans a daring robbery during a horse race. Its innovative non-linear structure foreshadowed Reservoir Dogs and many modern heist films.
6c7b8676: Which 2014 Damien Chazelle film is about a jazz drummer and his ruthless mentor?

Whiplash (2014), with Miles Teller and J.K. Simmons, follows a young jazz drummer and his instructor Fletcher, whose extreme methods spark debate. J.K. Simmons won the Oscar for Best Supporting Actor.
6b28d595: Which 2011 Terrence Malick film won the Palme d'Or at Cannes?
The Tree of Life (2011) won the Palme d'Or: a contemplative film about a 1950s American childhood, the nature of existence and the father-son relationship (Brad Pitt, Jessica Chastain).
1bbff028: Which actor is known for his extreme physical transformations in The Machinist and American Hustle?
Christian Bale lost nearly 30 kg for The Machinist (2004), then put a lot of weight back on to play Batman, and later for American Hustle.
4632494b: Which 1960 Jean-Luc Godard film launched the French New Wave?

Breathless (À bout de souffle, 1960), starring Jean-Paul Belmondo, was shot quickly with a light camera on the streets of Paris and revolutionized film language with its jump cuts and narrative freedom.
c9ce6655: Which 1994 Luc Besson film follows a hitman and a 12-year-old orphan?
Léon (1994), with Jean Reno and Natalie Portman: Léon, a professional hitman, takes in Mathilda after her family is massacred. The film launched Natalie Portman's international career.
8f6f51de: Which 2006 Guillermo del Toro film is set in Franco's Spain?
Pan's Labyrinth (El laberinto del fauno, 2006): a young girl escapes the violence of Franco's Spain into a mythological fantasy world.
4fdaccb7: Which actor plays Dominic Toretto in the Fast & Furious franchise?
Vin Diesel has played Dominic Toretto since the first Fast and the Furious (2001). The franchise has gone from street races to near-superspy missions with colossal budgets.
6282f069: Which 1982 Ridley Scott science fiction film adapts Philip K. Dick?

Blade Runner (1982) adapts Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?: Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford) hunts replicants in a rainy, dystopian Los Angeles of 2019. A cult film of cyberpunk and philosophical science fiction.
2f380e8e: Which Mexican director is known for Y tu mamá también and Gravity?
Alfonso Cuarón directed Y tu mamá también (2001), Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (2004), Gravity (2013, Best Director) and Roma (2018, 3 Oscars).
6c15b78e: Which Pixar animated film features a rat who dreams of becoming a chef in Paris?
In Ratatouille (2007), Remy, a rat passionate about cooking, teams up with Linguini, a clumsy young kitchen hand at Gusteau's restaurant.
83adea43: Which 1972 Francis Ford Coppola film features the Corleone family?
The Godfather (1972) is regularly cited among the greatest films ever made. Its sequel, The Godfather Part II, also won the Oscar for Best Picture.
67a44c4f: Which Bong Joon-ho film, made before Parasite, is about a serial killer?
Memories of Murder (2003) is based on the real Hwaseong serial murders (1986-1991): two detectives with opposite methods hunt an elusive killer. It is considered one of the best thrillers ever made.
c3647304: Which 2016 Japanese animated film tells of a boy's redemption after bullying a deaf classmate?
A Silent Voice (2016), directed by Naoko Yamada from Yoshitoki Ōima's manga, follows Shōya as he seeks forgiveness for bullying Shōko, a deaf student.
6196cccb: Which 2012 Michael Haneke film about old age won the Palme d'Or at Cannes?

Amour (2012), with Jean-Louis Trintignant and Emmanuelle Riva, follows an elderly Parisian couple facing illness and decline. It won the Palme d'Or and the Oscar for Best Foreign Language Film. Emmanuelle Riva became the oldest Best Actress nominee at the time.
f50c3474: What is the title of Greta Gerwig's record-breaking 2023 film with Margot Robbie?
Barbie (2023), with Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling, grossed about 1.44 billion dollars, the highest-grossing film ever directed solely by a woman.
bd94265d: Which French actor, born in Casablanca, plays the title role in Léon?
Jean Reno, born in Casablanca, became an international star with Léon (1994). He went on to appear in Mission: Impossible and The Da Vinci Code.
cdee37f5: Which 1957 Sidney Lumet film shows 12 jurors deliberating over a murder?
12 Angry Men (1957), with Henry Fonda: a lone juror holds out and forces the others to reconsider the case. A brilliant single-room film about justice, prejudice and reason.
9cff8ca8: Which 1999 David Fincher film with Brad Pitt had an ending that shocked the world?

In Fight Club (1999), with Brad Pitt and Edward Norton, the nameless Narrator starts a fight club with Tyler Durden. Its final twist and critique of consumer society make it one of the most discussed films ever.
0a716b8d: Which 1989 Spike Lee film is a tense portrait of a hot day in Brooklyn?
Do the Right Thing (1989) explores racial tensions in a Brooklyn neighborhood during a heatwave. Nominated for Oscars, it is considered Spike Lee's masterpiece.
8f3b4525: Which colossal 1962 David Lean film with Peter O'Toole runs nearly four hours and takes place in the desert?
The Bridge on the River Kwai

Lawrence of Arabia (1962) follows T.E. Lawrence (Peter O'Toole) as he unites Arab tribes against the Ottoman Empire. Shot in 70 mm, it won 7 Oscars, including Best Picture, with an iconic score by Maurice Jarre.
a44115f4: Which animated film popularized 3D CGI with Buzz Lightyear and Woody?
Pixar's Toy Story (1995) was the first feature film made entirely with computer animation. Revolutionary for its time, it launched the CGI era and transformed animation worldwide.
9ea6e8b3: Who directed Moonlight (2016), the first film with an all-Black cast to win the Oscar for Best Picture?
Barry Jenkins's Moonlight (2016) won Best Picture at a memorable ceremony. It follows a young gay Black man growing up in Miami, in three acts.
26e95be1: Which 1994 Robert Zemeckis film with Tom Hanks is a meditation on American history?

Forrest Gump (1994) follows a simple man through 30 years of American history: Vietnam, Watergate and more. It won 6 Oscars, including Best Picture. “Life is like a box of chocolates” is one of its most quoted lines.
ab153ba8: Which 2017 Luca Guadagnino film with Timothée Chalamet is set in 1980s Italy?
Call Me by Your Name (2017) follows Elio (Timothée Chalamet) falling in love with Oliver (Armie Hammer) at an Italian villa in the 1980s, adapted from André Aciman's novel.
e94480b3: Which film won the Palme d'Or at Cannes in 2024?
Sean Baker's Anora (2024) won the Palme d'Or: a young New York stripper marries the son of a Russian oligarch, causing chaos. Sean Baker is known for films about characters on society's margins.
3dc3eb60: Which 1939 John Ford film with John Wayne is an iconic western?
Stagecoach (1939) is the western that launched the genre's golden age: a stagecoach crosses Apache territory with passengers at odds with each other. It made John Wayne a star.
7bebf81a: Which film won the Oscar for Best Picture in 2024?
Christopher Nolan's Oppenheimer won seven Oscars in March 2024, including Best Picture and Best Director.
132ad22f: Which French actor won the Oscar for Best Actor for The Artist?
In 2012, Jean Dujardin became the first French actor to win the Oscar for Best Actor, for this black-and-white silent film.
371517d6: Which French actress won an Oscar for playing Édith Piaf in La Vie en Rose?
Marion Cotillard won the Oscar for Best Actress in 2008 for her performance as Édith Piaf.
6ce3bcb8: Steven Spielberg adapted Michael Crichton's novel. Its computer-generated dinosaurs were a revolution.
0c3ec987: Who directed The Lord of the Rings trilogy?
New Zealander Peter Jackson shot all three films in his home country. The Return of the King won 11 Oscars.
7311e9e6: Psycho's shower scene is one of the most famous in film history. Hitchcock was nicknamed the “Master of Suspense”.
7a952e9c: Luc Besson brought together Bruce Willis and Milla Jovovich in this science fiction film with costumes by Jean-Paul Gaultier.
c7680d73: Who directed Taxi Driver (1976), with Robert De Niro?
Taxi Driver won the Palme d'Or in 1976. The line “You talkin' to me?” became iconic.
a0c87f5f: Shot in black and white, La Haine follows three young men from the Paris suburbs over 24 hours. It won Mathieu Kassovitz the Best Director award at Cannes.
30ae3629: Who directed the horror film Get Out (2017)?
With his first film, Jordan Peele won the Oscar for Best Original Screenplay.
1f3c7b4a: In which saga do you hear “May the Force be with you”?
The Jedi and their allies have said it since the first Star Wars film in 1977.
e6bcf999: In which film does Marty McFly travel through time in a DeLorean?
In Back to the Future (1985), Marty is sent back to 1955 by Dr. Emmett Brown's machine.
e306e4f3: In which film does Neo take the red pill?
In The Matrix (1999), Morpheus offers Neo the blue pill to forget, or the red pill to learn the truth.
3cdb037c: In which 1939 film is Dorothy carried away by a tornado?
Judy Garland sings “Over the Rainbow” in it. The film switches from sepia to color when Dorothy arrives in Oz.
575c78bb: In which Stanley Kubrick film does Jack Torrance descend into madness in an isolated hotel?
The Shining (1980) adapts Stephen King. Jack Nicholson plays a writer who becomes caretaker of the Overlook Hotel.
4436a75b: Which serial killer does Anthony Hopkins play in The Silence of the Lambs?
Anthony Hopkins won the Oscar for Best Actor in 1992 for this role, with less than twenty minutes of screen time.
3c899d80: In which film is Tom Hanks stranded on an island with a volleyball named Wilson?
In Cast Away (2000), Chuck Noland, a FedEx employee, survives for years on a desert island.
121fec72: Which 1993 film sends Godefroy de Montmirail and Jacquouille into the future?
Jean-Marie Poiré's The Visitors (Les Visiteurs), with Christian Clavier and Jean Reno, drew nearly 14 million viewers in France.
60cf5f15: Which Francis Veber film features François Pignon, invited to a dinner to be mocked?
Le Père Noël est une ordure
In The Dinner Game (Le Dîner de cons, 1998), Jacques Villeret plays François Pignon opposite Thierry Lhermitte.
d45f949e: Which Justine Triet film won the Palme d'Or in 2023?
Justine Triet became the third woman director to win the Palme d'Or. The film also won the Oscar for Best Original Screenplay.
29717d9e: Which French pioneer made A Trip to the Moon in 1902?
Georges Méliès, a magician turned filmmaker, invented many special effects. The image of the rocket lodged in the Moon's eye is famous.
94d5a242: Which brothers held one of the first public film screenings in Paris in 1895?
On December 28, 1895, Auguste and Louis Lumière screened their films at the Grand Café in Paris.
2c374108: Which studio produced the animated film Shrek?
DreamWorks' Shrek (2001) won the very first Oscar for Best Animated Feature.
b9422bb1: What was Disney's first animated feature, released in 1937?
Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs was Walt Disney's first feature film and the first fully animated American feature.
434cbc0f: In The Lion King, what is the name of Simba's father?
Mufasa is killed by his brother Scar, who seizes the throne. Simba later returns to take back his place.
9ed42358: Which Pixar film takes place largely in the Mexican Land of the Dead?
In Coco (2017), young Miguel ends up in the Land of the Dead during the Mexican Day of the Dead.
0cc5e062: What is the name of the little clownfish his father searches for in a 2003 Pixar film?
In Finding Nemo, Marlin crosses the ocean with Dory to find his son Nemo.
09f2a924: Which actor plays Captain Jack Sparrow in Pirates of the Caribbean?
Johnny Depp played Jack Sparrow in five films, from 2003 to 2017.
467485e5: Which actor plays Iron Man in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
Robert Downey Jr. played Tony Stark from Iron Man (2008) to Avengers: Endgame (2019).
148d16cb: Which actress plays Hermione Granger in the Harry Potter films?
Emma Watson plays Hermione in all eight films, from 2001 to 2011. Bonnie Wright plays Ginny and Evanna Lynch Luna.
62dcf071: Which actor plays the Joker in The Dark Knight (2008)?
Heath Ledger won a posthumous Oscar for Best Supporting Actor for this Joker. Joaquin Phoenix is the Joker of the 2019 film.
6bbc5e6a: Arnold Schwarzenegger plays the cyborg in James Cameron's The Terminator (1984). “I'll be back” is his iconic line.
06b6cf68: Which actor plays Ethan Hunt in the Mission: Impossible saga?
Tom Cruise has played Ethan Hunt since 1996 and performs many of his own stunts.
1a2b728d: Which country does Bollywood cinema come from?
Bollywood refers to the Hindi-language film industry based in Mumbai (formerly Bombay). India is one of the world's largest film producers.
39236ba2: Which black-and-white Alfonso Cuarón film won the Golden Lion in 2018?
Roma tells the life of a domestic worker in 1970s Mexico City. It also won three Oscars.
4f9cd2ec: Which award is given to the best film at the Cannes Film Festival?
The Palme d'Or has been awarded since 1955. The Golden Lion goes to the best film at Venice and the Golden Bear at Berlin.
8c3e9a67: Which film festival awards the Golden Lion?
The Venice Film Festival, created in 1932, is the oldest film festival in the world.
60cbb99c: Which film festival awards the Golden Bear?
The Berlin International Film Festival, or Berlinale, awards its best film the Golden Bear, the bear being the city's emblem.
